Download Screenshots

Use these screenshots in App Store Connect for your product listing.

Or right-click any screenshot above to save as PNG.

How to Use in App Store Connect

  1. Save this page: Open in Chrome/Safari, print to PDF, or screenshot each phone above.
  2. Crop to size: App Store requires 6.5" screenshots at 1290×2796px or 1242×2688px
  3. Upload to App Store Connect: Go to your app → Pricing and Availability → Screenshots
  4. Add captions: Each screenshot can have text overlay in App Store Connect (recommended character limits: title 30 chars, subtitle 30 chars, description 170 chars)
  5. Order: Arrange screenshots in order shown (Log → Lures → Ranks → Spreads → Premium → Community)
